# bookmark-file-manager

> An embeddable file manager: a dependency-free front-end widget and a framework-free Node
> handler over a real filesystem. It browses, uploads, downloads, previews, searches,
> archives and edits files under one root directory — with a folder tree, thumbnails, a
> code editor, a spreadsheet editor, a document editor and a terminal. Published on npm as
> `bookmark-file-manager` (MIT, Node >= 18; repository name: Bookmark_file-manager).

**The two halves are independent.** The widget is a plain JS class that mounts into any DOM
element: no Bootstrap, no jQuery, no icon font, zero runtime dependencies, 98 KB JS + 7 KB
CSS gzipped (~26 KB of that is the four non-English languages). It works in React, Vue,
Angular, Svelte or no framework at all, because it is just the DOM. The back end is a
single `(req, res)` function that mounts in Express, AdonisJS, Fastify, Nest or bare
`node:http`; it starts no server of its own and keeps no global state. Its one dependency
is busboy; `sharp` is an optional peer, needed only for thumbnails and tiff/heic rendering.

**Install**

```bash
npm install bookmark-file-manager
```

**Quick start**

```js
// server
import express from 'express';
import { createFileManagerRouter } from 'bookmark-file-manager/server';

const app = express();
app.use('/api/files', createFileManagerRouter({ root: './storage' }));
app.listen(3000);
```

```js
// client
import { FileManager } from 'bookmark-file-manager';
import 'bookmark-file-manager/style.css';

const manager = new FileManager('#file-manager', { endpoint: '/api/files' });
```

The container needs a height (`<div id="file-manager" style="height: 600px"></div>`) — the
widget fills it completely.

**What it does.** Eight primary operations — new folder, new file, move, copy, rename,
delete, download (a file streams; a folder or multi-selection becomes a ZIP on the fly),
upload (multiple files, progress, cancellation, drag & drop). Their buttons are off the
toolbar by default and reached from the context menu and keyboard; `toolbarActions: true`
brings them back. Besides that: a lazily loaded folder tree, image thumbnails in the tiles
and a viewer for images and PDFs, properties and permission changes, 13 archive formats,
recursive search including inside file contents, a terminal with the manager's own
commands, spreadsheet editing (csv/xlsx/xls/ods), document editing (docx/odt/doc and PDF
page operations), a code editor with highlighting, grid and list views, breadcrumbs that
double-click into a typable address bar, full keyboard navigation and selection, a status
bar, five languages and light/dark themes.

**Widget options** (`new FileManager(target, options)`; `target` is an element or selector)

```js
{
  endpoint: '/api/files',   // base of the REST API
  provider: null,           // your own data source instead of HTTP
  locale: null,             // 'en' | 'uk' | 'es' | 'de' | 'fr' | your dictionary
  theme: null,              // colours, fonts and metrics
  rootLabel: null,          // label of the root in the tree and crumbs
  initialPath: '/',
  view: 'grid',             // 'grid' | 'list'
  iconBasePath: null,       // folder of per-extension artwork; null draws the icons
  permissions: null,        // { create, upload, move, copy, rename, remove, download, chmod }
  customizeThumbnail: null, // (entry) => URL | '<svg…>' | null
  preview: true,            // images and PDFs in a viewer over the widget
  thumbnails: true,
  sheets: true,             // csv/xlsx/xls/ods open in the spreadsheet editor
  code: true,               // text and source files open in the code editor
  documents: true,          // docx/odt/doc, and pdf page by page
  search: true,             // magnifier, Enter in the filter, Ctrl+Shift+F
  terminal: true,           // bottom panel; its button and Ctrl+` hide it
  showTree: true,  showToolbar: true,  toolbarActions: false,
  showStatusBar: true,  showSearch: true,  confirmDelete: true,
  headers: null,            // object or function — for authorisation tokens
  credentials: 'same-origin',
}
```

Client `permissions` remove the buttons of withheld operations rather than greying them
out; the server declares its own set in `/config` and the **intersection** applies — the
client cannot allow what the server forbids. Read the result with `manager.permissions` and
`manager.can('remove')`.

**Methods**

```js
await manager.ready;                 // the first listing is on screen
manager.navigate('/Documents');      manager.navigateUp();     manager.refresh();
manager.open(entry);                 manager.preview(entry?);
manager.showProperties();            manager.editPermissions();
manager.setExecutable(true);
manager.compress();                  manager.extract(entry);   manager.showArchiveContents(entry);
manager.openSheet(entry);            manager.openCode(entry);
manager.copyPath(path?);             manager.setView('list');
manager.getSelection();              manager.currentPath;      manager.readOnly;
manager.permissions;                 manager.can('remove');
manager.createFolder();  manager.createFile();  manager.moveSelection();
manager.copySelection(); manager.renameSelection(); manager.deleteSelection();
manager.downloadSelection(); manager.upload();
manager.destroy();                   // removes everything, listeners included
```

**Events.** `ready`, `navigate`, `selectionchange`, `open`, `created`, `renamed`, `moved`,
`copied`, `deleted`, `uploaded`, `download`, `viewchange`, `preview`, `chmod`, `archived`,
`extracted`, `codeopen`, `codesaved`, `sheetopen`, `sheetsaved`, `pathcopied`, `error`.
`on()` returns a function that unsubscribes.

**Handler options** (`createFileManagerRouter(options)` from `bookmark-file-manager/server`)

```js
{
  root: './storage',                      // required; created if missing
  readOnly: false,
  permissions: { create: true, upload: true, move: true, copy: true, rename: true,
                 remove: true, download: true, chmod: false, archive: true,
                 extract: true, edit: true },   // chmod is forbidden by default
  maxUploadSize: 100 * 1024 * 1024,       // per file
  maxUploadFiles: 50,                     // per request
  maxRequestSize: 1024 * 1024 * 1024,
  maxConcurrentUploads: 8,                // beyond that, 503
  maxBatchPaths: 1000,                    // per move/copy/delete/download/chmod
  maxSizeWalkEntries: 200000,
  archiveTools: true,                     // without external tools: zip, tar, tar.gz, gz
  archiveLimits: { maxEntries: 100000, maxTotalBytes: 5 * 1024 ** 3,
                   maxEntrySize: 2 * 1024 ** 3, toolTimeout: 10 * 60 * 1000 },
  minFreeSpace: 64 * 1024 * 1024,
  maxListEntries: 50000,                  // 0 means no ceiling
  maxTreeChildren: 2000,
  concurrency: 32,
  exposeUsage: false,                     // free space is the server's disk, not the user's
  thumbnails: true,
  thumbnailSizes: [64, 128, 256],         // a whitelist, not a hint
  maxRawThumbnailSize: 512 * 1024,
  thumbnailPixelLimit: 50 * 1024 * 1024,  // decompression-bomb guard, in pixels
  maxConcurrentThumbnails: 4,  maxQueuedThumbnails: 64,
  allowedOrigins: ['https://dashboard.example'],  // same-origin only by default
  authorize: (req, action, context) => true,      // context = { route, paths, destination, name }
  onWarning: (message, detail) => {},
}
```

**REST API.** `GET /config`, `/list?path=`, `/tree?path=&depth=`, `/stat?path=`,
`/thumbnail?path=&size=`, `/render?path=&width=`, `/properties?path=&size=`,
`/archive/list?path=`, `/sheet?path=`, `/document?path=`, `/search?path=&query=&mode=…`,
`/text?path=`, `/download?paths=…`. `POST /directory`, `/file`, `/rename`, `/move`,
`/copy`, `/delete`, `/chmod`, `/archive`, `/extract`, `/sheet/save`, `/document/save`,
`/document/pages`, `/text/save`, `/upload?path=`. All paths are **virtual**, relative to
`root` (`/Documents/report.txt`); absolute server paths never appear in a response.
`/download` and the image routes honour `Range` and `ETag`/`If-None-Match`. Errors come
back as `{ error, code }` with a meaningful status — `INVALID_NAME`, `INVALID_PATH`,
`OUTSIDE_ROOT`, `NOT_FOUND`, `EXISTS`, `READ_ONLY`, `PERMISSION_DENIED`, `INTO_SELF`,
`TOO_LARGE`, `NO_SPACE`, `CROSS_ORIGIN`, `TOO_MANY`, `BUSY`, plus families for archives
(`NOT_AN_ARCHIVE`, `ARCHIVE_TOO_LARGE`, `ARCHIVE_TIMEOUT`, …), sheets (`NOT_A_SHEET`,
`TOO_MANY_CELLS`, …), documents (`NOT_A_DOCUMENT`, `PDF_ENCRYPTED`, …) and search
(`INVALID_REGEX`, `SEARCH_FAILED`, …).

**Path rules.** A path being addressed is rejected only for a NUL byte or `..` (including
the backslash spelling); everything else the filesystem allows is shown as it is, because
`report?.txt` and `note:2026.md` are ordinary names on Linux and macOS. Names the client
asks to **create** are stricter — `/ \ : * ? " < > |` and control characters are refused
(`INVALID_NAME`), so a file created here survives being copied to Windows.

**Archives.** Thirteen formats. Own implementations for zip (Zip64 reader and writer) and
tar; `zlib` for gz and tar.gz; external tools for bz2, xz, zst, 7z and rar. RAR is
read-only. Extraction is guarded against traversal, bombs and runaway tools by
`archiveLimits`.

**Search** runs in a worker thread so a recursive walk cannot block the event loop. Masks,
regular expressions, extension filters, files-only or folders-only, and inside file
contents. The same engine backs the terminal's `find` and `grep`.

**Terminal commands.** `help`, `pwd`, `ls [-l]`, `cd`, `cat`, `stat`, `du`, `tree`, `find`,
`grep`, `mkdir`, `touch`, `rm`, `cp`, `mv`, `chmod`, `open`, `download`, `clear`.

**Your own data source.** The widget talks to a *provider*, not to `fetch` directly. Pass
an object implementing `config`, `list`, `tree`, `stat`, `createDirectory`, `createFile`,
`rename`, `move`, `copy`, `remove`, `upload` and `downloadUrl` to run it against S3, your
own RPC, or anything else. An entry is `{ name, path, isDirectory, size, modified }`.

**Languages and themes.** English (default), Ukrainian, Spanish, German, French, or your
own dictionary; server messages are translated by code, not by string matching. Light and
dark themes, with colours, fonts and metrics set at integration time or through plain CSS;
the layout adapts to its container's width and honours `prefers-reduced-motion`.

**Limitations.** ZIP is written without encryption and without unix permissions. A move
across devices is a copy plus a delete, so it is not atomic. Listings are chunked but not
virtualised — for directories of hundreds of thousands of entries, lean on search and
`maxListEntries`. No PDF thumbnails (PDFs open in the viewer). Large `.bmp` files get no
thumbnail. Animated gif/webp show their first frame in a tile and play in the viewer.

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Insider515/Bookmark_file-manager/master/README.md): the complete manual — every option, route, event, limit and failure mode, with the reasoning behind the defaults
- [README (Ukrainian)](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Insider515/Bookmark_file-manager/master/README.uk.md): the same text in Ukrainian
- [LICENSE](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Insider515/Bookmark_file-manager/master/LICENSE): MIT

## API reference

- [types/index.d.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Insider515/Bookmark_file-manager/master/types/index.d.ts): the widget's full typed surface — options, methods, events, provider shape
- [types/server.d.ts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Insider515/Bookmark_file-manager/master/types/server.d.ts): handler options, `FsOps`, archive and search helpers
- [src/index.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Insider515/Bookmark_file-manager/master/src/index.js): every client export, annotated
- [server/index.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Insider515/Bookmark_file-manager/master/server/index.js): every server export, annotated
- [server/router.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Insider515/Bookmark_file-manager/master/server/router.js): the REST routes end to end, with their guards
- [package.json](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Insider515/Bookmark_file-manager/master/package.json): entry points, exports map, peer dependencies

## Examples

- [demo/main.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Insider515/Bookmark_file-manager/master/demo/main.js): a working page with language, theme and option controls
- [demo/index.html](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Insider515/Bookmark_file-manager/master/demo/index.html): the markup it mounts into
- [server/standalone.js](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Insider515/Bookmark_file-manager/master/server/standalone.js): the demo server, and a minimal `node:http` mount

## Optional

- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/bookmark-file-manager): published releases
